**Errol Graham Musk** is a South African retired electrical and mechanical engineering consultant, property developer, and former politician. He is the father of business magnate [Elon Musk](Elon_Musk "Elon Musk"), restaurateur [Kimbal Musk](Kimbal_Musk "Kimbal Musk"), and filmmaker [Tosca Musk](Tosca_Musk "Tosca Musk"). He was married to [Maye Musk](Maye_Musk "Maye Musk").

## Biography

Errol Musk was born in South Africa.[[1]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:02-1) His mother was British and his father was South African.[[1]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:02-1) His father, Walter Henry James Musk, was an army sergeant.[[2]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:12-2)

In 1972, Musk was elected to the <Pretoria> City Council[[3]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-3) to represent [Sunnyside, Pretoria](Sunnyside%2C_Pretoria "Sunnyside, Pretoria").[[4]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:8-4): 52 He became a member of the [Progressive Federal Party](Progressive_Federal_Party "Progressive Federal Party") (PFP)[[4]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:8-4): 52 and ran as the PFP candidate in the 1981 election to represent Sunnyside.[[5]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:11-5): 225, fn 119 He resigned from the PFP in 1983.[[5]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:11-5): 225, fn 119

Musk worked as an electrical and mechanical engineering consultant and developed properties.[[1]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:02-1) He specialised in retail and office property development.[[6]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:9-6): 27

## Family life

Musk and [Maye Haldeman](Maye_Musk "Maye Musk") met in high school,[[11]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:4-11) dated as young adults, and married in 1970.[[4]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:8-4): 44 They had three children: Elon, born in 1971, then Kimbal, and later Tosca.[[11]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:4-11) The family lived in Pretoria, where Maye worked as a dietician and a model.[[11]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:4-11) After the end of the marriage in 1979, the children initially stayed with Maye, and Elon and Kimbal later moved in with their father.[[11]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-:4-11)[[12]](Errol_Musk#cite_note-12)
